summary: Plum Acquisition Corp. IV (SPAC) filed an 8-K reporting a second amendment to its Business Combination Agreement with Controlled Thermal Resources Holdings Inc. Key changes include reducing earnout shares from 100M to 70M, lowering merger consideration valuation from $4.5B to $3.15B, extending antitrust filing deadline to Sep 30, 2026, and closing deadline to Apr 30, 2027. The amendment also increases non-redeeming shareholder reimbursement shares to 3M. This is a de-SPAC transaction adjustment amid likely redemption pressure and regulatory delays. Watch for shareholder vote and trust redemptions; risk-arb spread may widen given valuation cut.
